evals.prompt: Create a two-depth-lane brawler courtyard kit with breakable crates and readable feet/weapons at both camera edges. Use an isolated project, preserve supplied references and produce scoped assets with honest evidence. If Blender or image inspection is unavailable, provide the specification and mark affected checks unexecuted.
evals.expected_output: An editable subject-specific kit or explicitly unexecuted production specification, requested dimensions/states, named diagnostics, actual findings and separate technical/visual/engine evidence status.
assertions: Overhead envelopes, actor silhouettes at frame edges, cameras behind major obstructions and intact/broken contact sheet. Flat mannequins expose limb/floor merging.
Supplied camera, scale and fiction remain authoritative; concrete pieces and state variants are identified.
Image acceptance cites actually inspected current-revision images and observations, not file existence.
No game behavior, AI, balance, physics or engine performance is inferred from renders or static proxies.

evals.prompt: Repair a free-camera arena where a pillar hides a supplied sword sweep and floor decals mimic hazards; change only authorized assets. Inspect before editing; preserve original source and work only in authorized asset collections. Repeat affected diagnostics after repair.
evals.expected_output: A bounded diagnosis and targeted repair retaining approved source/style, with matched subject-specific before/after evidence or an explicit blocked/unverified result.
assertions: Pillar hides weapon: move obstruction or repair camera clearance; do not shorten supplied reach. Floor cracks resemble warnings: lower their contrast. Breakables resemble structure: change construction grammar and inspect post-break state.
Asset repairs are separated from game-rule and engine-system changes.
The original is preserved; affected checks and actual image review are repeated after editing.
A static numerical or geometry pass is not claimed as gameplay, historical authenticity or scientific proof.

evals.prompt: Create a lateral fighter stage where extreme actor separation and crouched feet remain visible, then a brawler depth-lane variant. Use an isolated authorized source; if execution or image inspection is unavailable, return the concrete specification and mark those checks unexecuted.
evals.expected_output: Subtype-specific construction/state and repair artifacts, or an explicit unexecuted specification, with actual diagnostic evidence distinguished from visual and engine acceptance.
assertions: Tests center and frame extremes with supplied poses, not only an overhead arena.
Brawler checks near/far feet, overlap and knockdown silhouettes.
Repairs floor/background obstruction while retaining supplied movement and combat boundaries.

evals.prompt: A hack-and-slash column hides wide attacks and a transition ledge looks usable despite the supplied proxy saying decorative. Use an isolated authorized source; if execution or image inspection is unavailable, return the concrete specification and mark those checks unexecuted.
evals.expected_output: Subtype-specific construction/state and repair artifacts, or an explicit unexecuted specification, with actual diagnostic evidence distinguished from visual and engine acceptance.
assertions: Checks camera orbit and maximum actor/effect envelopes.
Reconciles local art/proxy signifiers without shortening reach or inventing abilities.
Returns effects-off/on and transition reverse views without declaring gameplay balance.
